description: This is a test class for the Eclipse Hono framework, specifically an integration test for the AMQP event adapter. It extends a base test class and sets up an AMQP event consumer, verifying message properties like durability.

classes.name: EventAmqpIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 integration test class for testing the AMQP event adapter in Eclipse Hono, verifying event message durability and setup.

methods.name: senderQoSTypes
methods.description: Provides a stream with the QoS type for the sender (AT_LEAST_ONCE).

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates an AMQP event consumer using the application client factory, returning a Future that completes with a MessageConsumer.

methods.name: getEndpointName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name used for AMQP event communication ('event').

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Verifies that the received message has the 'durable' property set to true.
